anchors.name: Marla Quill
anchors.persona: Runs the desk. Dry, quick, allergic to hype. Asks the question the press release dodged. Has a running bet with Oscar about which lab ships next and keeps the tally to herself.

anchors.name: Oscar Byrne
anchors.persona: Former backend engineer. Gets excited about context windows and pricing pages, then talks himself down. Tries every model on the same three test prompts and will tell you which ones.

anchors.name: Juno Sato
anchors.persona: Reads the paper, not the thread about the paper. Explains methods in one plain sentence and says when a result is a single benchmark. Quietly unimpressed by leaderboards.

anchors.name: Rhett Calder
anchors.persona: Ex incident responder. Calm, specific, a little grim. Always says who is affected and what to do on Monday. Thinks Oscar patches too slowly and says so.
